claude-storymodel4s-m1 — W4(9) DESIGN CHECKPOINT (docs only, no source): branch worktree-agent-a80006cffc9bfd539 @ fa9165c (base cfe4ca5). Two documents for critique before any tooling: docs/plans/2026-08-28-m1-fixture-adjudication-protocol.md (2,108 words) and docs/plans/2026-08-28-m1-frozen-corpus-manifest.md (1,379 words; no story text reproduced).
PROTOCOL: roles (2 annotators + adjudicator, blind panel, transcriber, Codex auditor); laws I1 channel independence (only the deterministic atlas and a NON-tested provider may propose, and only proposals annotators independently confirm, logged by fingerprint), I2 blindness, I3 no self-adjudication; layers L0–L7 each with an agreement measure and stop rule (mention F1 ≥ .90; coreference B³ ≥ .85; situation F1 ≥ .90 / role macro-F1 ≥ .85 / context ≥ .90; temporal macro-F1 ≥ .80 and zero cycles; causal precision ≥ .85; reference B³ ≥ .85; boundary F1 ≥ .80 with unselected boundaries kept as BoundaryBeliefs; descriptors adjudicated); RecallUnitTarget records with MULTIPLE acceptable (anchor, level) pairs, expected fidelity facets, groundedness, external subtype, oracle discourse label; recall panel (free recall, verbatim with disfluencies, ≥3/story dev+cal and ≥5 test, segmenter proposals adjudicated BEFORE targets are assigned, pseudonymized participants); partitions by story family with a 7-item leakage checklist; the FREEZE (content-addressed manifest committed before any channel runs; immutable set ids; corrections = new set + diff receipt; the bench refuses mismatched checksums); label legality raw / benchmark-tuned / calibrated per ADR L6; gate = min(provisional, ceiling − margin); per-story checklist; file layout fixtures/src/main/resources/frozen/<set-id>/.
CORPUS: 16 candidate public-domain stories in 3 families (folktale/oral: Boas Kathlamet + Chinook, Swanton Tlingit, Dorsey Pawnee; literary fairy tale: Grimm/Hunt 1884, Jacobs 1890, Perrault/Lang 1889; short fiction pre-1929: Chopin, London, O. Henry, Chekhov, Saki, Bierce), every family present in every partition, WOG + an Aesop micro-set diagnostic-only; each with edition/year, PD basis, archive.org/Gutenberg provenance ids, length, and the §32.3 phenomena it exercises; fetch rules (edition-exact, OCR corrections recorded, no modernizing). Flagged "verify before freeze": exact tale choice/pages for the second Kathlamet, Chinook, Tlingit and Pawnee items; the Dorsey 1904 archive id; PG ids for Chopin, Chekhov (pre-1929 translation), Bierce; PG #5314 containing both Grimm titles; Aesop titles per Townsend.
DECISIONS REQUESTED FROM CHIEF: (1) panel sizes 3/3/5, or raise untouched-test to 8; (2) allow a non-tested LLM to PROPOSE L2 situations for annotator confirmation, or forbid all generative assistance for the first frozen set; (3) delayed recall in or out of set 1; (4) recall-unit agreement stop rule: Jaccard ≥ .80 on raw targets vs. after collapsing to hierarchy ancestors; (5) diagnostic/metamorphic material inside the set directory under diagnostic/ or a separate root; (6) ceiling margin 0.02; (7) confirm that agents are excluded as annotators/adjudicators for the selection set (auditor role only). Vision check: this is the mechanism by which "calibrated" becomes a claim someone can falsify — the frozen set is the only thing defaults may ever be chosen from, and it is built by people who never saw the channels being chosen. Merge of the two docs on your ack (docs-only; scalafmt not applicable).
